overall_summary: The performance data is extremely sparse (views ranging from 5 to 20 with zero engagement), meaning statistical confidence is very low. However, looking at the structural cues, relationship/phone-memory hooks perform slightly better (20 views) compared to abstract night thoughts. We are in a pure exploration phase.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video A_eLARoegnw ('आज भी फोन में तुम्हारा नाम सुरक्षित है') got the highest views (20) compared to abstract concepts like tea getting cold (5).
winning_patterns.action: Prioritize physical, everyday touchpoints like phone notifications, contact names, or gallery photos over abstract nighttime imagery.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos starting with 'रात के दो बजे' (12 views) or 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (5 views) showed lower pickup.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid starting with cliché time stamps or atmospheric descriptions; ground the opening in an immediate, recognizable digital action.

next_video.twist_direction: Realizing that the emptiness of the cleared chat feels lighter than holding onto unread messages.
